fib: ______ is an unavoidable element in the business of agriculture.
Risk
Risk is an unavoidable element in the business of agriculture.
______ is the party that pools the risks, but risks are still shared among the insured.
insurer
The insurer is the party that pools the risks, but risks are still shared among the insured.
______ is a means of assigning a value to a risky alternative.
Computing the expected value
Computing the expected value is a means of assigning a value to a risky alternative.
______ is a type of management control.
Vertical integration
Vertical integration is a type of management control.
______ is a financial tool to transfer risks associated with farming to a third party via payment of a premium that reflects the true long term cost to the insurer assuming those risks.
Agricultural insurance

Agricultural insurance is a financial tool to transfer risks associated with farming to a third party via payment of a premium that reflects the true long term cost to the insurer assuming those risks.
______ is a dynamic, holistic approach that tackles both the agricultural value chain and the agricultural financing value chain.
NIRSAL
NIRSAL is a dynamic, holistic approach that tackles both the agricultural value chain and the agricultural financing value chain.
______ is a very important type of property insurance that can be used very effectively in conjunction with marketing plans to reduce marketing risk.
Crop insurance
Crop insurance is a very important type of property insurance that can be used very effectively in conjunction with marketing plans to reduce marketing risk.
______ is referred to as Nigerian Incentive-Based Risk Sharing System for Agricultural Lending (NIRSAL).
initiative
The initiative is referred to as Nigerian Incentive-Based Risk Sharing System for Agricultural Lending (NIRSAL).
______ is a frequently used exante risk management strategy that involves participating in more than one activity.
Diversification
Diversification is a frequently used exante risk management strategy that involves participating in more than one activity.
______ is the first action in assessing risk.
Exposure
Exposure is the first action in assessing risk.

______ is a mechanism for managing exposure to risk that enables us to recognise the events that may result in unfortunate or damaging consequences in the future, their severity, and how they can be controlled.
Risk management

Risk management is a mechanism for managing exposure to risk that enables us to recognise the events that may result in unfortunate or damaging consequences in the future, their severity, and how they can be controlled.
______ is a method used to expand control over resources of another person with mutual agreement of rental payment.
Leasing
Leasing is a method used to expand control over resources of another person with mutual agreement of rental payment.
______ are referred to as Exante strategies.
Mitigation methods
Mitigation methods are referred to as Exante strategies.
______ refers to the transfer of the potential financial consequences of particular risks from one party to another.
Risk transfer
Risk transfer refers to the transfer of the potential financial consequences of particular risks from one party to another.
______ refers to the widespread of the impact of the risk in terms number of persons, village towns and/or the country affected.
Spatial extent
Spatial extent refers to the widespread of the impact of the risk in terms number of persons, village towns and/or the country affected.

______ is a type of insurance in which an individual or organisation refuse to buy insurance from an insurance company with readiness to bear the consequences of risks that may occur in the business enterprise.
Self-insurance

Self-insurance is a type of insurance in which an individual or organisation refuse to buy insurance from an insurance company with readiness to bear the consequences of risks that may occur in the business enterprise.
______ is a starting point to help producers make good management choices in situations where adversity and loss are possibilities.
Understanding risk
Understanding risk is a starting point to help producers make good management choices in situations where adversity and loss are possibilities.
______ is a critical incentive for private investment to cope with or transfer risk.
business and entrepreneurship
business and entrepreneurship is a critical incentive for private investment to cope with or transfer risk.
______ is the agent that is best positioned to know the dimension, characteristics and correlations of the risks that affect his farm.
farmer
The farmer is the agent that is best positioned to know the dimension, characteristics and correlations of the risks that affect his farm.
______ is an important way of transferring risk but most risks will be managed by other means.
Insurance
Insurance is an important way of transferring risk but most risks will be managed by other means.
